camel_example: aliyun domain ListEmailVerification --region cn-hangzhou --VerificationStatus 1 --Email 'username@example.com' --PageNum 1 --PageSize 500 --UserClientIp '127.0.0.1' --Lang en --BeginCreateTime 1522080000000 --EndCreateTime 1522080000000 --version 2018-01-29 --method POST --force
description_en: Invoke the ListEmailVerification API to query the email verification list
description_zh: 调用ListEmailVerification接口查询邮箱验证列表
kebab_example: aliyun domain list-email-verification --lang en --begin-create-time 1522080000000 --end-create-time 1522080000000 --email username@example.com --verification-status 1 --page-num 1 --page-size 500 --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEmailVerification

parameters.help_en:
Language of error messages returned by the API. Valid values:  
zh: Chinese.  
en: English.  

Default value is en.
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认值为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The start time for querying email verification creation, represented as the number of milliseconds since 00:00 on January 1, 1970, UTC.
parameters.help_zh: 查询创建邮箱验证的开始时间，计算方式为UTC时间1970年1月1日0点距离现在的毫秒数
parameters.name: begin_create_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for querying the creation of email verification, calculated as the number of milliseconds since 00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
parameters.help_zh: 查询创建邮箱验证的结束时间，计算方式为UTC时间1970年1月1日0点距离现在的毫秒数
parameters.name: end_create_time

parameters.help_en: The email address to query. You can upload only one email address at a time.
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的邮箱地址，每次仅可上传一个邮箱
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en:
Email verification status. Valid values:  
0: Waiting for verification.  
1: Verification succeeded.
parameters.help_zh:
邮箱验证状态。取值：
0：等待验证。
1：验证成功。
parameters.name: verification_status

parameters.help_en: The page number for paging through the domain list. Default value is 1. You can set this parameter based on your needs.
parameters.help_zh: 域名列表分页的页码，默认值为1，可根据自身需求进行设置
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The page size for paging through the domain list. Default value is 500, and the maximum value is 5000. You can set this parameter based on your needs.
parameters.help_zh: 域名列表分页的大小，默认值为500，最大值为5000，可根据自身需求设置
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: User IP address. You can set it to 127.0.0.1.
parameters.name: user_client_ip
